statements.quote: AI and High-Performance Computing can help us cut through that by optimizing how we operate existing infrastructure and getting more out of every line and generator.
statements.context: Introducing the Affordable Innovation for the Grid Act with Rep. Kevin Mullin, directing the Energy Department to assess how AI can speed grid interconnection studies.
statements.reason: Promotes using AI to improve the power grid and does not acknowledge any catastrophic risk from AI.

statements.quote: Understanding how AI and HPCs can help our bulk-power system run on full power will be critical to ensuring affordable rates for the long term.
